fact: The 2026 finance law (Loi n° 2025-021) makes the Tax Administration (DGI) deploy the Integrated Tax Administration System (SAFI), and requires each commune to collect and consolidate the information for land-tax assessment and transmit it to the competent national tax centre, with collection moved from communes to the tax administration and Treasury.
title: Loi n° 2025-021 portant loi de finances pour 2026
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances
